summary: @ornikar/rollup-config 11.1.6 preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime (v1.3.13) from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file math_init.js in the package directory. math_init.js is a 727KB '// @bun @bun-cjs' compiled artifact obfuscated with rotated string arrays (WV8StW rotator, hex-named locals, large numeric/string constant tables, base64-like alphabet). Using an alternate JS runtime specifically to execute a heavily obfuscated bundled payload at install time evades Node-based install-time analysis and does not match the package's stated rollup-configuration purpose. The behavior is not documented in CHANGELOG.md (which stops at 11.1.1) or README, and the preinstall script, setup.mjs, and math_init.js are not present in prior releases — the shape is consistent with a hijacked release published against a legitimate downstream user base.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
